|notes=The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Voyeur (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Voyeur (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The original explicitly says three or more opposing non-battleground locations. The later slip prints three. Both activate 5 Force and retain the single battleground location deployment in the Lost mode. 
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards5.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #49 on 14 September 2007); page 4, slip 50. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Voyeur]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time#Cards|Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
* Earlier versions: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf first release sheet of 30 May 2003] and [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf revised sheet labeled 19 June 2003] (old pre-Remaster slips).
